events.title: Intro to Web Accessibility
events.description: A 90-minute hands-on session on making React apps usable with a keyboard and a screen reader. Bring a laptop with Node installed.

events.title: Open Parliamentary Debate Night
events.description: Four teams, one motion announced fifteen minutes before the first speech. Spectators welcome to stay for the adjudication.

events.title: Golden Hour Photo Walk
events.description: A slow walk around campus at sunset. Phone cameras are fine. The guild lends out three cameras on a first come, first served basis.

events.title: Line-Follower Robot Build
events.description: Teams of three build a small line-following robot from a kit. The club supplies the kits, so the seat limit matches the number of kits.

events.title: Kapampangan Language Circle
events.description: Conversation practice for beginners and heritage speakers. This week covers greetings, numbers, and ordering at the canteen.

events.title: Git Rescue Clinic
events.description: Bring the repository you broke. Officers help untangle merge conflicts, detached heads, and the commit that should never have been pushed.

events.title: Public Speaking Basics
events.description: A morning workshop on structuring a three-minute talk, with short practice rounds in pairs.

events.title: Editing Phone Photos
events.description: Free apps only. Cropping, light, and colour, using photos from the golden hour walk.

events.title: Robot Race Finals
events.description: The line-follower teams race on a new track. Seats are for spectators; teams register separately with the club.

events.title: Sisig and Stories Night
events.description: Members share family recipes and the stories behind them. Food is served, so the headcount has to be real.
